This houseboat is a mysterious boat that will\ntake you where you want to go.\nAll aboard~!
Huh. Huuuhhh?!
Wha... What's going on?? Just now I thought\nthere were two beautiful ladies beside you...
Huh?! What the hay is going on here?
It looks like now Tenert can also see the\nfairies...
The boat uses a mysterious power to form a\nspecial force field around it. Maybe Tenert is\nable to see us because of that power...
But the boat's force field is limited, so when\nyou disembark, we become invisible again.
I see... You disappear when I step off the\nplank... Anyway, it's my first time to see you\nbut you two are really gorgeous...
Oh yea, I haven't introduced myself. I'm Tenert,\nthe leader of the Support Caravan for Adventurers.\nIt's a pleasure to make your acquaintance.
What a gentleman!\nI'm Cersier of the Sakura Fairies.
And I'm Sherry. You might already know, \nbut we're sisters.
It... it's a... p-pleasure!
Alright then, let's set sail to see Sherry's\nmost beautiful recommended sights. Sherry?
Yes, let's depart.
It looks like Libera and Virgo aren't here...
Not here yet, huh. I wonder if they got caught\nup in some trouble. Better go look for 'em.
You don't have to do all that...
Weren't we instructed to wait here?
That's true, but in order to help those trees,\nwe need some Parasiverto to remove the\ncrystal, right?
In that case, we should all collect the materials\nand have Virgo make it for us and bring it here.\nSo I'm gonna go look for him...
I-It's so kind of you to consider this world...
Thank you!!
Aw shucks, well I... Anyway! What about you lot?\n...Oh yeah, back to your adventure, huh... I'd\nappreciate some help,but it's up to you.
Well, I guess here's where we part ways. Let's\nmeet again sometime somewhere. Later!
Thank you, too, adventurer.\nThanks to you two, we defeated the monsters and\nsaved trees that were possessed by the crystal.
It's nothing special, but please have this... And\nplease visit us again soon. The trees should be\nreturning to normal again soon.
Adventurer! Have you come to visit us again?
It's just as Tenert said, you've really\ncome to visit again!!
Ohh! Speak of the devil. We were just talking\nabout you...\nWe'd like you to help us out again.
It seems these two saw more of those monsters\nwe beat before. We should hunt them down and\ngive 'em what they've got coming.
You'll help out, right? ...Yea, that's the spirit!\nLet's go get 'em!
We're counting on you, Sherry.
Right, let's go then!
Well, I guess this is where we part ways... Hm?\nA monster? Ahh, I guess they're still hiding.\nBut we won't let 'em slip by...
Let's keep an eye on this place when we have time.\nAlso can I call you when I need help?\nOK, let's meet again. Later!
Thank you also, adventurer.\nThanks to the two of you, everything is fine now.\nIt's nothing special, but this is for you...
Please come again soon. Tenert comes around\noften, so I think you can meet again if you return\nsoon.
Everything seems to be fine here...\nBut even so, some monsters have appeared\nthat are after our friends' tree...
We Sakura Tree Spirits have no power to fight.\nEven in the face of aggression, we only have\nthe power to endure...
However thanks to you and Tenert, not just ours\nbut also our friends' tree is saved.\nWe are all ever so grateful.
Ah, thank you...Thoughts? Well, nothing important,\njust that there are so many worlds, from yours to\nthe ones where monsters live...
I suppose I've become curious from all\nthe stories I've heard about your world\nfrom Tenert.
We can't leave this world to go see them all,\nso please continue to tell us lots about your\nworld.
Anyway, where do you think the monsters\nthat possessed me and Sherry came from?
It doesn't seem very likely that they would\ncome all the way here just to take our power...
Huh? ...So they ate up all the nutrients in their\nown world and fled to other worlds in hunger?\nI suppose that is a possibility.
If they're draining all the nutrients there are,\nthen waiting will only lead to self-destruction...
Anyway, I'm sorry I always seem to be asking\nyou to get rid of monsters.
We can't leave this world or even protect\nourselves. All we can do is, make\nthe flowers blossom...
Huh? ...You mean that's enough?\nWe should just heal those who fight the monsters\nby making the flowers bloom?
But since that's all we can do... I've got it!\nWe will bloom the most beautiful flowers\npossible for those protecting us!
Before we took out monsters coming to attack,\nbut this time a stray monster. What is this?
Draining the Sakura tree spirits for nutrients...\nSometimes I think... They're terrible.\nIf they came to our world... Ugh.
All the trees and flowers of the world would be\ndestroyed in a flash. I wonder what we can do\nto prevent it... Think about it, eh?
H-Hey, what's up? ...What? Am I looking pale?\nNothing... I'd like to say but you're right.\n*gag* I've got seasick...
...Huh? Well, I've only ever lived on solid ground.\nThat was my first time to be in such a shaky place...\n*gag*
...What? No way! They would be disappointed to\nhear that I got seasick!!
Well, I'll get well soon.\nI'm not scared of monsters or any...\nWhoa?! H-Hey, make way!!
